{{nihongo|'''Inasaki Shrine'''|稲前神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mikawa Province]].

It is said to be the oldest shrine in Okazaki<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url=https://okazaki-kanko.jp/point/506 | title=Inasaki Shrine |website=Okazaki Outing Navi |publisher=Okazaki City Tourism Association | accessdate=2022-01-05 }}</ref>.

=== Overview ===
Inasaki Shrine is regarded as one of the two Shikinaisha of {{ill|Nukata District|Q787290|qid=Q787290}} in ancient {{ill|Mikawa Province|ar|مقاطعة ميكاوا|ckb|پارێزگای میکاوا|cs|Provincie Mikawa|de|Provinz Mikawa|eo|Provinco Mikaŭa|es|Provincia de Mikawa|fa|ولایت میکاوا|fi|Mikawan provinssi|fr|Province de Mikawa|gl|Provincia de Mikawa|hak|Mikawa-koet|id|Provinsi Mikawa|it|Mikawa (provincia)|ja|三河国|ko|미카와국|lt|Mikavos žemė|nl|Mikawa (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Mikawa|pt|Província de Mikawa|ru|Микава (провинция)|simple|Mikawa Province|sk|Mikawa|sr|Провинција Микава|th|แคว้นมิกาวะ|tr|Mikawa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Мікава|ur|میکاوا صوبہ|zh|三河國|zh_classical|三河國|zh_min_nan|Mikawa-kok|zh_yue|三河國|qid=Q768158}}, listed in volumes 9 and 10 of the '{{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}}' {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=register of deities}}.

Its foundation is thought to date back to the {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}}, and in the "Mikawa Kokunai Shinmei Meichō," said to have formed from the late {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}} to the {{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}}, it is recorded as "Junior Fifth Rank Lower, Inakuma Tenjin seated in {{ill|Nukata District|Q787290|qid=Q787290}}." Part of Inakuma-gō is said to have been shrine territory of {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|Q687168|qid=Q687168}} for a period from the late medieval to early modern era. Therefore it can be inferred that the shrine had already been built by the time private landed estates ({{ill|Shōen|Q1887569|qid=Q1887569}}) advanced{{Sfn|『岡崎 史跡と文化財めぐり』|p=69}}.

Records say Inasaki Shrine was once on the site of {{ill|Okazaki Castle|Q1013445|qid=Q1013445}}, but when the Kō clan, who ruled Nukata, restored Sōji-ji, it was moved to {{ill|Zaimoku-chō, Okazaki|Q17224231|qid=Q17224231|lt=Zaimoku-chō}}. Later, in the {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} era ({{ill|1573|Q6678|qid=Q6678}}-{{ill|1591|Q6766|qid=Q6766}}), it was moved to Inakuma due to expansion of Okazaki Castle{{Sfn|『岡崎 史跡と文化財めぐり』|p=69}}.

=== Transportation ===
* {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397}}: get off at "Inakuma 2-chōme" stop bound for Ōnuma, then 100 meters north.
